name: PACOSTEP
detailed_description:
About Game

A tree world consumed by darkness. Paco, you are the only one left. Purify your family and neighbors, and bring light back to the ruined village.

Paco Step is a hardcore adventure platformer game where you’ll experience both exploration and challenge. As you progress through stages, the difficulty deepens—and powerful boss battles await you.

Gameplay

The game progresses by clearing stages.

Stages are divided based on bosses.

Various Movement Systems

The following movement systems appear as the main mechanics of each stage. Beyond these, even more types of movement are waiting to be discovered—experience them for yourself in-game!

[Jump Platform]

Jump in a specific direction to move forward.

[Dash Ball]

Use Dash Balls to break or move obstacles and open up new paths.

[Ally Dash Healer]

A friendly monster that shares Dash Balls. Time it right to collect the life balls and move forward.

Game Systems

Dash Save System
Touching the Tree of Life during gameplay automatically saves your progress. Since no UI operation is required, it keeps your flow uninterrupted.

Spirit System
A system that allows you to scout the map in advance. Hold the Z key to let Paco’s spirit freely roam the map, helping you explore and plan your route.

Crystal Collect System
Crystals that offer bonus points are hidden throughout the map, often in hard-to-reach places. Try collecting them all!

Attack System
You can attack monsters using a dash.
While dashing, you are invincible—charge through enemies as you progress!

Arena System
Each map includes an arena system where you can practice and learn the stage’s main mechanic. Deepen your experience with the various gimmicks in Paco Step.

Side Map System
These are optional stages separate from the main route.
They offer high-difficulty puzzles for players who enjoy the hardcore genre.
